title: Airbnb Metric4 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:metric4
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day airbnb metric4 (4) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on airbnb metric4 (4) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It helps you what time of day your airbnb metric4 (4) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
